The '''Sandcrawler Training Facility''' was contained within the [[Sandcrawler/Legends|sandcrawler]] of the [[Nkik clan]] of [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]]. In that facility, the [[Droid builder/Legends|droid builders]] of the clan would learn how to control the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] they built. Before going on a mission to infiltrate an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[hidden droid factory]], an [[Unidentified Rebel agent (droid builder)|undercover agent]] from the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] trained in that facility for a time.
